p0_findings.title: Parent-only nonzero payload faults but can still commit the accepted event
evidence: rtl_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_island.sv:419-420 replaces a synthetic-parent payload with zero for arithmetic.
rtl_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_island.sv:458-461 does not include the required issue_residual_data==0 predicate in base_issue_ready_w.
rtl_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_island.sv:476-477 and 497-503 can therefore accept, write/elope, commit psum and complete the row.
rtl_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_island.sv:584-586 only raises the sticky fault in parallel with that architectural event.

verif_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_assertions.sv:81 disables assertions on imminent_protocol_fault, so the parent-only zero assertion at 133-136 is disabled in the exact cycle that should prove atomic blocking.
p0_findings.impact: This violates the frozen rule that every format/protocol failure blocks the entire accepted event. A malformed parent-only beat can produce an architectural commit before protocol_error becomes visible.
p0_findings.minimum_repair: In the top, derive an explicit preaccept protocol predicate that includes synthetic-parent implies issue_residual_data==0 and gate issue_data_ready, psum_write_valid, row_complete_valid, scratch write/elision and issue_accept with it. Add a directed malformed-parent-only attack proving zero architectural events before the sticky fault. Do not change matcher, ordering, queue, dead/live policy, arithmetic widths, macro organization or claim boundary.

p1_findings.title: Overflow can be evaluated and latched using an unavailable or stale parent response
evidence: rtl_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_island.sv:417-418 selects slot0_data_q whenever the row has a parent, independent of slot validity and identity.
rtl_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_island.sv:434-453 computes row/psum overflow from that value.
rtl_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_island.sv:581-583 latches overflow whenever a held final payload is valid, without parent_ready_w.
verif_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_assertions.sv:146-153 explicitly permits a valid payload to be held while ready is low.
p1_findings.impact: A legal held final payload can spuriously poison the task before the correct parent response reaches slot0, even though no event was accepted.
p1_findings.minimum_repair: Qualify architectural overflow evaluation/fault and overflow debug intent with a matching parent response, or mask parent data until parent_ready_w and only latch overflow when all arithmetic operands are authoritative. Preserve the existing backpressure and atomic-output protocol. Add a directed held-final test with a stale positive slot and a later legal non-overflowing parent.

p1_findings.title: The scoreboard has no independent dead/live refcount oracle or M528 event-counter oracle
evidence: tb_m528_dw1rw/tb_m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture.sv:153-197 computes parent, residual, population and numeric output but not reference parent refcounts or an expected live bitmap.
tb_m528_dw1rw/tb_m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture.sv:265-347 checks requests, arithmetic, stable commit order and self-conservation only.
verif_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_assertions.sv:98-107 consumes DUT current_live/live_bitmap, so a common-mode live-map error can satisfy the assertions.
count_issue_stalls is not connected to the SVA and no reference macro-read/write/forward/hold/stall totals are checked at task_done.
p1_findings.impact: A wrong parent-live bitmap can turn dead rows into live writes or live rows into elisions while the current PASS token, numeric output and self-conservation all remain internally consistent.
p1_findings.minimum_repair: Extend the TB cleanroom reference with per-row parent refcount and expected_live, compare the complete DUT live bitmap after matcher handoff, and compare expected live writes, dead elisions, parent edges and the relevant read/forward/hold/stall totals. Keep the reference independent of DUT directory/live signals.

p1_findings.title: Named functional covers are advisory and cannot block the runner PASS
evidence: verif_m528_dw1rw/m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture_assertions.sv:184-225 declares covers, but the runner does not request or parse a coverage database/report.

tb_m528_dw1rw/tb_m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture.sv:483-489 gates only five protocol attacks; it does not gate dead-plus-read, deadline read/write, dual enqueue, queue-full no-credit, alternating/consecutive liveness, stalled RAW recovery, ping-pong, endpoint rows or all-slice activity.
dc_handoff/scripts/run_vcs_m529_m528_dead_write_only_1rw_exact_sha.sh:159-164 accepts the single PASS token and failure-signature absence without any named-cover count.
The SVA default disable condition includes imminent_protocol_fault, so attack covers are not a reliable substitute for the TB attack counter.
p1_findings.impact: The exact runner may print PASS while one or more frozen protocol corner cases were never exercised.
p1_findings.minimum_repair: Add explicit reproducible TB hit flags/counters for every required normal cover and fatal on any zero count; keep the five attack counters separate. Emit one exact coverage-summary token and make the runner require exactly one token with all minima satisfied. SVA covers may remain diagnostic.

p1_findings.title: The contract's trace-recurrence and 1.50x gates are not implemented and must not be conflated with the unit VCS attempt
evidence: contracts/m529_m528_dead_write_only_1rw_source_only_contract_r1_20260827.json places the 435293339-cycle recurrence and two 1.50x gates under future_vcs_obligations.
tb_m528_dw1rw/tb_m528_dead_write_only_1rw_product_capture.sv contains only small directed/random synthetic tasks and no frozen H67 trace replay or candidate-cycle comparison.
dc_handoff/scripts/run_vcs_m529_m528_dead_write_only_1rw_exact_sha.sh has no trace identity, recurrence receipt or speedup-gate check.
p1_findings.impact: Calling the single unit-test VCS result the complete frozen VCS gate would overstate validation, while embedding CPU DSE into this runner would mix incompatible attempt identities.
p1_findings.minimum_repair: Revise the source contract/handoff to separate: (A) one functional VCS directed/random/attack/cover attempt; (B) a later independently admitted trace-driven RTL/cycle recurrence attempt bound to the frozen trace and 435293339 reference; and (C) the already sealed M528-r4 CPU DSE as a precondition only, not rerun inside VCS. Derive the 1.50x checks only in the trace-recurrence receipt against the frozen 760350133 and 757946784 denominators.

p2_findings.finding: The VCS foundry .v binding is executable and exact-SHA, while DC .db and Formality nine-cutpoint bindings are currently declarative plans only.
p2_findings.required_future_action: Before any DC or Formality admission, author and independently hammer separate exact-SHA scripts that link the .db in DC, never compile the behavioral .v, reject inferred parent arrays/non-nine macro counts, and match all nine macro instances and slice/control/address cutpoints in Formality. This does not block a repaired functional VCS source package.

p2_findings.finding: The complete top is structurally explicit, but the 64-way matcher and two 1152-bit response slots remain high physical-risk standard-cell logic.
p2_findings.required_future_action: Preserve the single admitted structure and judge it only with macro-inclusive DC/STA and matched throughput-per-total-area gates; do not add a second matcher, second lookahead or hidden fallback.
